# Intuitech Fantasy (league-2) -- Monday Briefing, Week 2

## Source and freshness

**Live, but Week 1's report is the newest one that exists.** `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returned live (182 rows), but every row is dated to the Week 1 report -- `load_injuries(2026, week=2)` came back empty (0 rows), which is expected on a Monday: teams don't file Week 2 practice reports until Wed/Thu. Sleeper and ESPN news/injury endpoints were proxy-blocked (403), as expected in this sandbox. FantasyPros consensus was skipped (no API key). Every projection below is the in-house rate-based tier, run through `generate_report.py`'s availability model (freshly fitted this run on 2021-2025, AUC-class model per `availability.py`) -- **with the rolling-volume/Vegas blend turned off**, because it collapsed the entire 993-player pool to near-zero conditional points with only one game of 2026 history (see Caveats). All `playProbability` values come from depth-chart + shrunk-play-rate features, not a current designation -- there isn't one yet.

**Week note:** `season_week.py`'s own detector still reports Week 1, because the Chiefs @ Broncos Monday-nighter hadn't been played as of this run -- but no rostered player is on either team, so this briefing treats **Week 2** as the actionable week throughout.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | If-he-plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Jaxson Dart | @LAR | **16.85** | 17.72 | 95.1% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @KC | **14.71** | 15.95 | 92.2% |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs CLE | **12.58** | 13.64 | 92.2% |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @ARI | **14.34** | 15.13 | 94.8% |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @HOU | **6.33** | 7.71 | 82.1% |
| TE | Harold Fannin Jr. | @TB | **4.59** | 5.02 | 91.5% |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | @LAR | **9.83** | 10.66 | 92.2% |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @BUF | **6.18** | 7.53 | 82.1% |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs LV | **5.44** | 5.58 | 97.5% |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @TEN | **4.98** | 4.98 | 100% |

**Lineup total (expected): 95.83.**

**Bench:** Matthew Stafford (QB, 10.00 exp), Drake London (WR, 5.92), Josh Downs (WR, 5.20), Quentin Johnston (WR, 4.49), Brock Bowers (TE, 4.53 -- see below).

One flip worth calling out plainly: **start Fannin over Bowers at TE.** The model has them essentially tied (4.59 vs 4.53), but Bowers didn't play a single snap in Week 1 -- ruled Out with a knee injury, did not practice all week. There's no Week 2 designation yet either way, so this is the healthy body over the unresolved one until Wednesday says otherwise.

## Changes since Saturday's briefing (Week 1, total 124.92)

- **Bowers benched for the first time.** Saturday's briefing flagged his DNP risk (p=0.76) but still started him -- he ended up not playing at all. This week Fannin gets the nod.
- **Skattebo holds his flex spot.** 81 rush yards + a TD in Week 1 looks like a real role, not a matchup fluke -- no roster action needed.
- **Everything else reset for new Week 2 opponents.** The drop from 124.92 to 95.83 is not a real decline -- Week 1's number leaned on the week-1 cold-start model, and Week 2's leans on one game of shrinkage-heavy, small-sample estimates. Trust the *ranking* within this list more than the absolute total this early.

## Watch list

- **Brock Bowers (TE) -- knee.** Out and DNP all of Week 1; no Week 2 tag yet. If he's Questionable-or-worse again, Fannin is already the right start per this briefing. If he's a full go, worth a second look before Sunday.
- **The whole WR bench/flex tier (Higgins, Williams, London, Downs) is bunched within 2 points of each other on a single game of data.** This ordering is genuinely unsettled and will likely reshuffle once real Week 2 practice reports and a second week of production land -- re-check Wednesday night.

## Opponent notes

- Bowers' Week 2 matchup (@LAC) doesn't matter until his own health is resolved -- don't read anything into it yet.

## Byes ahead

**None in the next two weeks.** First cluster to plan around: **Week 6**, where Tee Higgins (CIN) and Jameson Williams (DET) -- both currently in your flex mix -- are on bye the same week. Nothing to do yet, but start watching the waiver wire for WR depth as Week 6 approaches; five bench spots go fast with two same-position byes landing together.

## Caveats

- `season_week.py` disagreed with reality on which week is "current" (see above) -- resolved manually, not silently.
- No Week 2 injury report exists anywhere yet; confirmed via a direct, empty `load_injuries(2026, week=2)` call. Expected for a Monday, not a data failure.
- **The rolling-volume + Vegas blend (`blend.py`) looked broken at this point in the season** -- with one game of 2026 history it drove the entire 993-player pool to implausible near-zero conditional points (top WR league-wide: 6.0 pts; top TE: 4.1 pts). This run used `--skip-blend` and fell back to the calibrated rolling-average tier instead. Worth a look by whoever's driving the backend before the next report leans on it.
- Sleeper/ESPN proxy-blocked as expected; FantasyPros skipped (no key in this sandbox).
- Only `frontend/public/mock/league-2/briefings/2026-09-14-mon.json` and the briefings `index.json` manifest were touched.
